url.title: Invoice URL
url.description: Link to an e-invoice: UBL 2.1 or CII XML (XRechnung, Peppol BIS, EN 16931) or a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF (max 25 MB). Leave empty when you use another field.

file_base64.title: Invoice file (base64)
file_base64.description: The invoice file (XML or Factur-X/ZUGFeRD PDF) as base64, instead of a URL.

xml.title: Invoice XML (text)
xml.description: The invoice XML pasted as text, instead of a URL.

profile.title: Rules
profile.description: Which rules to apply. Auto reads the invoice's specification identifier: EN 16931 always, plus Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 or XRechnung 3.0 when the invoice declares them.

invoices.title: Invoices (batch)
invoices.description: Up to 100 per run: [{"url": "..."}, {"file_base64": "...", "name": "INV-1.pdf"}, {"xml": "<Invoice ...>"}]. Clear 'Invoice URL' when you use this.
